entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return. I bought these shoes and I'm just so confused by them.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes?

Well, they just don't feel right. I tried to attach the little metal things, the... cleats? The instructions were confusing. I finally got them on and tried a class, but I got terrible blisters on my heels.
I'm very sorry to hear they caused blisters, that's no good at all. So just to be clear, is it a technical fault with the shoe, or more of a preference and fit issue?
I... I don't know, I guess a fit issue? I just don't understand them and they hurt my feet. The whole process is overwhelming. Can't you just help me? I just want to get a refund and send them back.
Of course, I can absolutely help with that. Let me just pull up your order information. I see here that the shoes were delivered 22 days ago.
Oh, is that a problem? I saw something on the website but I didn't understand it.

Not at all. I'm checking our policy right now, and it states that you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return. So you are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for you immediately.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can get a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. Once we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, a full refund will be issued to your original method of payment. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for making it so easy, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
